title: Man shot by RCMP dies in hospital
article: The 39-year-old man shot by North Vancouver RCMP Saturday afternoon near Deep Cove has died. Matthew John Wilcox died in hospital last night while recovering from surgery. Police are not saying whether Wilcox was armed when he was stopped by RCMP officers.

Vancouver Police have taken over the investigation and RCMP say Wilcox was shot after he refused to obey their commands after being pulled over on the Mount Seymour Parkway. Wilcox had been in RCMP custody earlier that day, but was released before the shooting. An autopsy will be conducted to figure out the exact cause of death.

Vancouver Police Constable Lindsey Houghton says Wilcox had a previous criminal record. "Certainly our investigators will be looking at every piece of detail in Mr. Wilcox's past and his history, and certainly be speaking extensively with both witnesses and the officers that were involved."
